entries.label: t09_01
entries.text: Welcome to Alfornada, a town where you can\nsee the stars and find excellent pottery.

entries.label: t09_02
entries.text: My family’s been making pottery for generations!\nIsn’t that cool?

entries.label: t09_03
entries.text: The water’s trickling out...\c\nI wish it’d shoot out like Hydro Pump, though.\nWouldn’t that be neat?

entries.label: t09_05
entries.text: This plate’s huuuge! How big of a sandwich d’you\nthink would fit on it?

entries.label: t09_06
entries.text: Tableware made in Alfornada is popular all\nacross Paldea!

entries.label: t09_07
entries.text: Pottery is born from the kiln!\c\nPotters put shaped clay inside and let it fire nice\nand slow for days.

entries.label: t09_19
entries.text: The battle court here was originally built as an\nobservatory to view the stars.

entries.label: t09_23
entries.text: There was a Pokémon that reminded me of tea\nup the hilly road ahead here.

entries.label: t09_24
entries.text:
Wasn’t it rough coming all the way out to
Alfornada?\c
But now that you’ve been here once, you can use
the Flying Taxi to come back whenever you want.

entries.label: t09_30
entries.text: Alfornada is in such an inconvenient location!\nHaving a trusty Cyclizar is an absolute must here.

entries.label: t09_40
entries.text: I actually came to see the Gym Leader, Tulip. But\nthese plates are super cute too!

entries.label: t09_43
entries.text: The Pokémon mosaic art on the observatory is\nreally cute, isn’t it?\c\nIt reminds me of some kind of old video game!
